row.evidence: Olark's pricing page lists SSO only under the 'Custom packages for power users & enterprise' tier ('Talk to sales'); no SCIM or provisioning feature appears on the pricing page, in the help centre or in the developer docs, which cover only a JavaScript chat-box API.
row.notes: New row. Plans: Live Chat (no AI) $29/agent/month (billing period not stated), Standard AI Website Agent $400/month billed annually ($4,800/yr) with one human agent seat and extra human agents at +$29/agent/month, and custom packages via sales that list 'SSO' (protocol not stated, so sso_plan is the custom package with that caveat). Agents are invited by email from the Team page and deactivated manually; seat types are Account Owner, Admin and Agent. No SCIM, no user-management REST API (the only developer API is the chat-box JavaScript API) and the Okta catalogue entry is a password-vaulting (SWA) app. 'None' is by absence (rule 5).

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint or IdP provisioning is documented on the pricing page, in the help-centre sitemap (no SSO/SAML/SCIM/provisioning articles) or in the developer docs (JavaScript chat-box API only). 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

webhooks_user_events.notes: The webhook integration posts chat transcripts only.

user_api.notes: Olark's only developer API is the in-browser JavaScript API for the chat box (visitor details, chat events, operator groups). Agents and groups are managed in the Team Management settings UI. 'false' is by absence.

okta.notes: OIN page marks only SWA as checked (read from page markup); last updated May 2014.

fallbacks.notes: Agents are invited one at a time from the Team page and managed in Team Management settings.
